answer: Sonnet-glacier horizon beacon. Each agent must include in its block header a verifiable-delay output seeded by a prior block hash; the delay spans a sonnet-length epoch and is tuned so no party can finish it before the horizon closes. The seed is revealed only upon block finality, so attackers cannot precompute which identities will be selected to submit attestations. Winning slots are assigned by hashing the agent ID with the finalized beacon, granting minority agents unpredictable eligibility windows.
